scope: Follow the actual head-conversion offspring after unassisted ordinary paid maturation from its original birth location. One unrelated simple adult mate and one supported encounter after natural cooldown; a conception already accepted autonomously during readiness is retained rather than retried. Pregnancy carrier is resolved by sex, not presumed to be the candidate. Mate/candidate placement is staged; no food, candidate age/genome/body/reserve edits, cooldown reset, forced consent, repeated acceptance attempts or mutation boost. Not an autonomous ecosystem frequency or player-guided trial.
